title: a bound's omission marker is suppressed when --fields projects it away (task list and task view)
description:
Unblocked 2026-10-06 by DEC-161 (k) (opum-doc, ruling A; opum-ai/opum-doc#749). RULE: when a bound is supplied (for example --max-notes) AND the projection names the bounded field, the omission marker (notesOmitted) is emitted BESIDE the projected keys, under the same key name it has in unprojected output. When the projection does not name the bounded field, no marker is emitted, because nothing the caller asked for was cut. --fields output is therefore the named keys plus any omission marker for a named key. task view --fields and task list --fields behave the same way. DEC-161 (h) is unchanged: a projection itself reports no fieldsOmitted.

EXACT REPRO before the fix (reported by the QCLI-291 round-2 review, wf_f7e8997d-b28): quest task view <id> --max-notes 0 --fields implementationNotes --json returned data {implementationNotes: []} with NO notesOmitted, while quest task view <id> --max-notes 0 --json returned notesOmitted:1. task list has no field-level bound (its --limit bounds the array, not a field), so the same rule leaves it with no marker.

acceptanceCriteria.text: task view --fields emits notesOmitted beside the projected keys exactly when a bound (--max-notes) was supplied AND implementationNotes is among the named fields; when implementationNotes is not named, no marker is emitted; with no bound, never a marker
task list --fields follows the same rule through a shared projection code path (no field-level bound, so no marker, and its output is unchanged)
Tests pin BOTH sides of the names-the-bounded-field condition for BOTH commands

plan: 1. Share the --fields projection between task list and task view in main.ts so the bound-marker rule is one code path.
2. Rule per DEC-161 (k): when --max-notes was supplied AND implementationNotes is a named field, add notesOmitted beside the projected keys, copied from the source record; otherwise no marker.
3. Tests: both sides for task view (names it / does not), and task list unchanged; plus no-bound cases.
4. Independent review-assignment, then land. Confirm DEC-161 (k) is on opum-doc origin/dev before merging.
implementationNotes: QCLI-462 delivered in opum-ai/quest-cli#521. DEC-161 (k) implemented as one shared projectFields(source, fields, boundMarkers) helper in src/cli/main.ts, used by BOTH task list --fields and task view --fields. The marker notesOmitted is emitted beside the projected keys exactly when the bound was supplied (--max-notes) and its bounded field (implementationNotes) is among the named fields; it is copied from the record, never recomputed; no marker otherwise, and never a fieldsOmitted key (DEC-161 (h)). task list has no field-level bound, so it passes no marker map and is unchanged. The exact repro now returns {implementationNotes: [], notesOmitted: <full>}. Help (both commands) and the overview guide updated. Independent review approve, with a positive control (the suite reds 2/10 against pre-fix cc201ee2). bun run check exit 0 on ef52405c. DEC-161 (k) confirmed present on opum-doc origin/dev before the PR.
finalSummary: Delivered in opum-ai/quest-cli#521 (DEC-161 (k), opum-doc). One shared projectFields(source, fields, boundMarkers) helper in src/cli/main.ts now backs both task list --fields and task view --fields. The omission marker notesOmitted is emitted beside the projected keys exactly when a bound was supplied and its bounded field is among the named fields, copied from the record never recomputed; no marker otherwise; no fieldsOmitted ever (DEC-161 (h)). task list has no field-level bound, so it is unchanged. The filed repro now returns {implementationNotes: [], notesOmitted: <full count>}. Help and the overview guide updated. Reviewed once, approve, with a positive control (2/10 red against pre-fix cc201ee2); bun run check exit 0. All three criteria checked; AC2 recorded as wording-limited for task list (no field-level bound, so only its no-marker side is expressible).
